content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DLSA Dima Hasao Para Legal Volunteers Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://dimahasaojudiciary.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 03-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the District Legal Services Authority Dima Hasao (DLSA Dima Hasao) in the state of Assam for engaging eligible candidates on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Para Legal Volunteers (PLVs), offering a total of 20 vacancies for qualified individuals willing to serve within the jurisdiction of Dima Hasao.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 20 vacancies available for the Para Legal Volunteers (PLVs) position under the District Legal Services Authority Dima Hasao recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Para Legal Volunteers (PLVs) post must possess a minimum educational qualification of HSLC (10th standard) from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applicants must be a minimum of 18 years of age as specified in the official notification to be eligible to apply for the Para Legal Volunteers position.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of offline applications is 03 October 2026. Applications must reach the designated authority on or before 05:00 P.M. on this date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for DLSA Dima Hasao Recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly offline. Candidates must fill out the prescribed standard form and submit it either by post or via the designated drop box.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: Applications should be addressed to The District & Sessions Judge-cum-Chairman, District Legal Services Authority, Dima Hasao, P.O & P.S Haflong, Pin 788819.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises the shortlisting of candidates for an interview, followed by the interview and selection stage, and a subsequent training programme.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and access further details by visiting the official judiciary website at http://dimahasaojudiciary.gov.in.
